messages:
Anya: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for Console Insights (observability) launch next quarter. Two customer asks currently blocking: per-route token/cost breakdown and distributed trace hooks that map request -> model/version. Can we align on MVP?

Jason: +1. We should also define launch SLOs and rollback criteria.

Maria: For UX: we'll need a Cost by Route chart, a trace inspector drawer, and a small CSV export flow. I can mock the main screens but need the API shape.

Tomer: Tracing note — capturing model_id & shard info is critical for debugging. Preferred approach is an agent-side hook (sidecar) to attach metadata at request enqueue time. That has infra implications for Private customers.

Luke: From sales: AcmeHealth expects per-customer cost CSVs and retention policy. Starlite asked specifically to tie traces to prompt versions and surfaced errors. Both want an easy rollback story if costs spike.

Jason: Implementation tradeoffs: full-fidelity traces for every request will increase observability traffic and add ~2-4% CPU/GPU overhead (depends on batching). Options: 1) 1% sampling by default + deterministic sampling for canaries, 2) on-demand full traces for specific routes or request ids, 3) store aggregated metrics (token counts, latency percentiles) for all requests and keep traces only for sampled/flagged events.

Anya: Draft launch criteria (proposal):
- Per-route cost chart available in Console (tokens, model, cost)
- Trace sampling implemented with model_id tagging + trace inspector UI
- CSV export for per-customer/per-route cost for last 90 days
- Perf budget: observability overhead <= 5% p99 tail on typical workloads
- Rollout plan: canary 5% → 25% → 100% with automatic fallback to aggregated-only mode
- Docs + API/SDK changes published

Maria: UX notes: the trace inspector should show a token breakdown, latency waterfall, model switch points, and a direct link to the prompt set that produced the trace. Mockup: https://figma.com/redwood/console-insights (internal)

Tomer: Ops constraints: Private on-prem installs will need a config toggle to keep trace payloads in-customer VPC (no outbound telemetry). We'll need clear KMS/HSM requirements for any traces with PII and a flag to sanitize prompts.

Jason: Quick config example for sampling we discussed:
```yaml
tracing:
  enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.01 # default 1%
  deterministic_routes: ["/generate", "/chat"]
  headers_to_capture: ["x-rdw-model-id", "x-rdw-route"]
  store_traces_in_customer_vpc: false
```

Luke: I'll confirm with AcmeHealth and Starlite on retention windows and whether sanitized prompts are acceptable vs full prompts. Also asking if they want raw traces delivered as S3 exports.

Anya: Action items: Jason — spike tracing hook perf & cost delta (ETA Tue), Maria — final mocks + copy (ETA Fri), Tomer — list infra/security changes for Private (ETA Wed), Luke — customer acceptance criteria + export requirements (ETA Thu). I'll draft launch PRD once we have spikes + mocks.

ConsoleBot: Ticket created -> RDW-6523 (Console Insights: scope + launch criteria). Assigned: Jason, Maria, Tomer, Luke, Anya. Due: 2026-04-02. :white_check_mark:

Anya: Anything missing? If not, I'll convert these into the PRD sections and share for review tomorrow. :slightly_smiling_face:
